extracted.subtask_description: Information and requirements for choosing and using Hulu subscription plans, bundles, add-ons, and Live TV features, including pricing, eligibility, device and regional restrictions, and promotional terms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Plan pricing and stated savings
rubrics_metrics.description: Show plan options and monthly prices; display claimed savings compared to purchasing services separately.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples include: 'Bundle plans starting at $12.99/month.' 'Save 41% per month with a Disney+, Hulu, HBO Max Bundle. Plans start at $19.99/mo.' 'Savings compared to regular monthly price of each service.' Also includes promotional first-month pricing (e.g., '$9.99/month your first month') and explicit monthly prices for each bundle tier (e.g., $12.99/mo, $19.99/mo, $35.99/mo).

rubrics_metrics.name: Promotional terms and limitations
rubrics_metrics.description: Promotions have eligibility, duration, non-combinability, and redemption rules.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples and requirements: 'Offer for Hulu (With Ads) + Live TV plan only: $64.99/month for 3 months, then auto-renews at then-current regular monthly price.' 'Not combinable with any free trial or any other promotional offers or pricing (including any bundle); not redeemable via gift card.' 'Any plan switch after redemption of this offer will result in forfeiture of the discount pricing.' 'Ends 3:00 PM PT on 11/18/25.' 'New and eligible returning subscribers (who have not been Hulu subscribers in the past 1 month) only.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligibility for offers
rubrics_metrics.description: Who may redeem offers and bundles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Stated restrictions: 'U.S. residents, 18+ only.' 'New and eligible returning subscribers only; select third party billed subscribers and current Disney+ and/or ESPN+ subscribers are not eligible.' 'Available only for direct-billed purchases via Disney+, Hulu, and HBO Max.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Geographic and regional availability / blackouts
rubrics_metrics.description: Content and Live TV availability depend on location and are subject to change; some content may be blacked out.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Phrasing from page: 'Live TV is available in the 50 United States and the District of Columbia only.' 'Live TV is available for those live local, regional, and national channels available in your area, which are subject to change.' 'Programming subject to regional availability, blackouts, and device restrictions.' 'Location data required to watch certain content.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Channel availability by ZIP / localized channel lists
rubrics_metrics.description: Channel lineups and availability vary by the customer's ZIP code.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Instruction: 'Enter your home ZIP code for channels available in your area.' Also: 'Click here to check channel availability in your area.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Device and technical requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements for devices and network to stream Hulu and Live TV.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Stated requirements: 'Compatible device and high-speed, broadband Internet connection required.' 'Multiple concurrent streams and HD content may require higher bandwidth.' 'Location data required to access content.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Concurrent streams and device limits
rubrics_metrics.description: Limits on how many devices can stream simultaneously depend on plan and service.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: 'Watch on 2 different screens at the same time.' 'Stream on 4 devices at once' (Disney+). 'Hulu content can be streamed via Disney+ on up to 2 devices simultaneously.' 'Number of permitted concurrent streams will vary based on the terms of your subscription.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Ad behavior and ad-supported exceptions
rubrics_metrics.description: Which plans include ads and where ads may still appear despite ad-free claims.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notations: 'Both with ads, for $12.99/month.' 'No ads in Hulu streaming library' (Premium) but also: 'Due to streaming rights, a few shows are not included in the Hulu Premium plan and will instead play interruption-free with a short ad break before and after each episode.' 'Ads will be served in select live and linear content.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Content access across apps and separate access rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Access to Disney+, Hulu, and ESPN content may be via separate apps/sites and is subject to cross-service limitations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Details: 'Enjoy all your favorite shows, movies, sports, and more using the Disney+, Hulu, and ESPN+ apps (or sites, for those on a browser). Download each app separately to access each service.' 'Select Hulu content available via Disney+ with valid Hulu and Disney+ subscriptions; additional content only available via Hulu app.' 'Includes access to Disney+ content and additional ESPN Unlimited content in their separate apps.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Download and offline viewing limits
rubrics_metrics.description: Some titles can be downloaded to supported devices for offline viewing; not all content available.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Statements: 'Download select Hulu titles to your supported device for on-the-go-streaming. Save your data and watch offline.' 'Download select Disney+ titles to your supported device for on-the-go-streaming.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Live TV features and DVR
rubrics_metrics.description: Live TV plan features include access to channels, Unlimited DVR, and fast-forwarding of DVR content under stated limits.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: 'Watch Live TV From 100+ Channels.' 'With Unlimited DVR, store Live TV recordings for up to nine months and fast-forward through your DVR content.' 'Live TV plan required. Regional restrictions, blackouts and additional terms apply.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Cancellation, plan switching, and refunds
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules on canceling, switching plans, timing of effect, and refund policy for partial months.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explicit rules: 'Cancel anytime.' 'Hulu (With Ads) + Live TV plan $89.99/mo. after 3-day free trial (if any) unless canceled. Cancel anytime.' 'Switches from Live TV to Hulu take effect as of the next billing cycle.' 'Cancel anytime, effective at the end of your billing period. No refunds or credits for partial months.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Add-ons and extra-cost packages
rubrics_metrics.description: Optional additional channel packages and themed add-ons available for an extra monthly fee.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples listed: 'HBO Max, CINEMAX®, Paramount+ with SHOWTIME, STARZ®' and specific add-ons like 'Entertainment Add-on $7.99/month', 'Sports Add-on', 'Español Add-on $4.99/month.' 'Add-ons available at an additional cost. Add them up after you sign up for Hulu.'

rubrics_metrics.name: ESPN Unlimited and feature-specific notes
rubrics_metrics.description: Details and limitations specific to ESPN Unlimited within bundles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Statements: 'ESPN Unlimited (With Ads) which includes all ESPN networks and services, including ESPN+.' 'ESPN Unlimited includes all ESPN networks and services... more than 47,000 live events per year.' 'Additional features and functionalities available only in the ESPN App and on ESPN.com, and do not require purchasing through ESPN.' 'Content subject to change. Blackouts and other terms & restrictions apply.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Subscriber agreements, terms of use, and where to get details
rubrics_metrics.description: Subscription use is governed by service-specific agreements and help center resources.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: References: 'Subject to Disney+, ESPN, and Hulu Subscriber Agreement.' 'For detailed information on billing and cancelation, please visit the Hulu Help Center.' 'Use of Disney+, Hulu, and HBO Max are subject to their respective terms and conditions, see each of Disney+ Subscriber Agreement, Hulu Subscriber Agreement, and HBO Max Terms of Use.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Intended use restriction
rubrics_metrics.description: Limit on permitted use of the service.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Plain statement: 'For personal and non-commercial use only.'
